Created `wordcount.rb`:

```ruby
#!/usr/bin/env ruby

verbose = ARGV.delete("--verbose")
filename = ARGV.first or abort "Usage: #{$0} [--verbose] FILENAME"

text = File.read(filename)

puts "Words: #{text.split.size}"
puts "Lines: #{text.lines.count}" if verbose
```

The flag works in any position (`wordcount.rb --verbose file.txt` or `wordcount.rb file.txt --verbose`). Tested: 5 words, 2 lines for a two-line sample file.
